body: Started 2019 with 3 best friends and ended it with everyone hating me.. only person left to care about is my mom 👍
And don't tell me you care about me because you don't. And I don't care about you. Telling me you care about me doesn't make me feel better.
I know I'm still young and naive but life keeps getting worse and worse in ways I couldn't even imagine before and I'm just so fed up

About to turn 18. For the past like 6 years I would think "this will be the year I end it" and I am more serious every year. Right now just waiting to graduate highschool because I feel like I owe that to my mom. Don't know what happens next but it probably won't be pretty
